name: XLA_PROD_ACCT_HEADERS
description: This table optionally contains the accounting headers types for a Application Accounting Definition and event class or type. If not specified, a flag must be set to indicate that no accounting is required for the combination of the Application Accounting Definition and the event class or type.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Accounting methods builder context.

columns.name: PRODUCT_RULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to indicate whether the product rule is created by user or predefined by the application.

columns.name: PRODUCT_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Application accounting definition code.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an entity and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event class and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event type and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the description is predefined by subledger application.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_CODE
columns.description: Short name of the elements of a description that appear on the subledger journal header and line. The definition determines both the content and sequence in which the elements of the description appear.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Internal flag. Indicates if accounting is required  for this product rule and event class or type.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: VALIDATION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Comment: Indicate the validation status of an event class and event type assignment.

columns.name: LOCKING_STATUS_FLAG
columns.description: 'N' - Unlocked.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ACCT_RULE_DEFINITION_ID
columns.description: Accounting rule definition identifier

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
